long_biography.plain_text:
Trained in automated control systems at the Moscow Institute of Railway Transport Engineers, Vekselberg began as a scientific researcher before entering private business during the late Soviet period. His technical background later informed a move beyond extractive industries toward solar generation, advanced technology and education.

Renova established Hevel as an integrated solar business covering module development, manufacturing and power-plant operation. Vekselberg also led the Skolkovo innovation project and became chairman of Skoltech's board of trustees, moving to deputy chairman in 2026. Separately, his Link of Times foundation assembled a major decorative-arts collection and founded a Fabergé museum in St. Petersburg.
